description: This file defines a BottomSheet UI component for Android, including its layout, behavior, actions, and builder pattern for configuration.

classes.name: BottomSheet
classes.description: A BottomSheetDialogFragment subclass that displays a customizable bottom sheet with actions and header.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Action
classes.description: Parcelable class representing an action item in the bottom sheet, including title, icon, and click behavior.

classes.name: BottomSheet.Builder
classes.description: Builder class for constructing a set of actions to be displayed in the BottomSheet.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Creates and returns the view hierarchy for the bottom sheet, including header and actions.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures the bottom sheet behavior after the view has been created, setting it to expanded state.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Static method to display the bottom sheet with specified header, actions, and configuration.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Adds an action to the builder with a string title and icon, with optional dismissal after click.
